Downtown Customer Parking

STREET PARKING (359 Shopper Spots)

Metered Street Parking can be paid with quarters at the meter head or with the ParkMobile App

 

2 Hours (288 spots)

Westwood Avenue (57)                                                          Bergen Street (10)

Center Avenue (49)                                                                Jefferson Avenue (14)

Fairview Avenue from Irvington to Bergen (36)                     Washington Avenue (8)

Broadway (50)                                                                        Third Avenue (27)

Kinderkamack Road (8)                                                          Madison Ave (19)

and Municipal Lots (see below)                                              Park Avenue (6)

3 Hours (26 spots) Grey head meters

Jefferson Avenue from Center to Fairview (26)  

and Municipal Lots (see below) 

9 Hours (45 spots) Blue head meters

Fairview Avenue between Westwood & Irvington (8 spaces)

Third Avenue to Elm Street (6 spaces)

Broadway (West side at Irvington) (16 spaces)

Kinderkamack Road between Westwood and Irvington (7 spaces)

Westwood Avenue East of Kinderkamack (12 spaces)

and Municipal Lots (see below) 

MUNICIPAL LOTS (253 Shopper Spots)

Municipal Lot Parking can be paid with cash at MasterMeter/meters or with the ParkMobile App

 

3 hours (43 spots)

Fairview Avenue Lot (west side) (43) ***

2 hours (141 spots)

Center Avenue Lot North (North of Westwood Avenue) (77) ***

Center Square Lot* (North of Westwood Avenue) (61) Public Parking at metered spaces only

Firehouse Lot (South end of Center Ave. NEXT TO Fire House parking) (13)

9 hours (56 spots) 

Center Avenue Lot South (south of Westwood Avenue near Bergen Street) (56) ***

 

ON SATURDAY ONLY

Municipal Building Parking lot 101 Washington Avenue (93) 

 

DOWNTOWN EMPLOYEE PARKING (96)

Downtown Businesses should purchase hang tags for their employees to park at yellow-headed meters (0.25 cents for four hours) in the following locations:

 

Fairview Avenue (Bergen to Jefferson both sides of the Street) (40)

Fairview Avenue Lot (13) as designated by yellow poles and signage

Center Avenue Lot North (13)**

Madison Avenue (north of Irvington Street) (9) 

Fourth Avenue (west side from Washington to Park) (5) 

Washington Avenue (between Fourth and & Irvington, northside) (3) 

Center Avenue South (South of Westwood Avenue near Bergen Street) (12) as designated by yellow signage (spots 55-66)

Broadway between Grand and Irvington (7)

 

*Privately owned lot whose revenue is donated to the Parking Utility

**0.25 per hour

*** Contains 4 EV charging stations                                                                                                        Rev. 7/6/25
